recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast mixed-media collage featuring black-and-white high-contrast portraits with jagged, hand-torn edges arranged in a circular flow over a vibrant, textured abstract background of impasto paint strokes and paper scraps.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome human figures against a multi-colored chaotic background
Jagged, torn-edge framing of portraits versus fluid, organic paint strokes
Circular arrangement of peripheral elements around a central rectangular focal point
coreInvariants: Visible paper grain and torn edges
Impasto paint texture with visible brushwork
Black border framing the entire composition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Multiple small-scale portraits arranged in a loose oval around the perimeter; a central rectangular abstract painting acts as the core.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central light-blue rectangle with a rainbow-like arch and white impasto dots.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion starting from the top left, following the curve of the portraits down the left side and up the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and filled with overlapping textures and shapes.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Multi-colored pastel and primary mix (yellow, green, pink, blue) in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and stark white in the photographic cutouts.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant coral-red organic shape in the lower center.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the painted elements contrasts with the zero-saturation B&W portraits.

letterConstructionRules: Varying line weight suggestive of a felt-tip marker
Connected lowercase letters with detached capitals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'T' in the top-left is elongated and sharp
The 'D' in the top-right has a large, open loop
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single handwritten style used for all text to maintain a personal, 'scrapbook' feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the DIY, punk-adjacent aesthetic of the 80s new wave era.
Complements the painted textures in the background.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a mixed-media collage with a black outer border. The center should feature a textured, multi-colored abstract painting with impasto strokes in yellow, green, and pink. Arrange 8-10 high-contrast black and white portraits of people with 80s hairstyles, each with jagged torn-paper edges, in a circular pattern around the center. Include a central rectangular inset with a light blue arch and thick white paint dots.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white handwritten marker-style text in the top-left and top-right corners, sitting directly on the black border.

verificationChecks: Are the portrait edges jagged and torn rather than clean-cut?
Is the background texture visibly thick and painterly?
Is the text rendered in a casual, white script?
Does the black border frame the entire image?

mustRedesign: Specific placement of every paint stroke

mustAchieve: High-contrast B&W tonal range for photos

postGenerationChecks: Check for visible paper grain in the cutouts
Ensure the white text is legible against the black border
Verify the central 'arch' element is present
Confirm the portraits follow a circular flow
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [High-Contrast B&W Portraits] with [Torn Edges] over a [Multi-colored Impasto Abstract] background, framed by a [Solid Black Border] with [White Marker Script] in the upper corners.
